title: Buyer interview synthesis and competitor feature-gap matrix for model lifecycle readiness
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Objective: run a focused buyer research sprint to capture how enterprise and mid-market buyers evaluate inference platforms with respect to model lifecycle readiness (model onboarding, versioning, quantization/variant support, rollback and A/B, observability for regressions, and procurement constraints). Deliver a prioritized competitor feature-gap matrix that maps capabilities across deployment modes (hosted, dedicated, private) and a synthesized buyer decision model to inform short-term product bets and a drafting of 6 candidate PM tickets for Q2 work. Scope: top 8 competing offerings (open and managed), 18–22 buyer interviews split across engineering buyers (platform/infra), ML leads (model owners), and procurement/security stakeholders. Output: 1) buyer-interview highlights deck with verbatim problem statements and decision triggers; 2) competitor feature-gap matrix CSV (12 axes x 8 vendors) and narrative; 3) prioritized backlog with expected impact KPIs and suggested signal experiments; 4) executive one-pager recommending immediate product trade-offs for Dedicated vs Hosted differences. Success criteria are actionable product decisions and alignment with commercial/sales commitments for Dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: 18+ buyer interviews completed with summaries and timestamped highlights uploaded to Drive

Feature-gap matrix completed covering at least 8 competitors and 12 capability axes (onboarding, versioning, quantization profiles, rollout control, auditability, latency SLAs, cost levers, rollback/fallback) in CSV and narrative form
Prioritized backlog of at least 6 PM tickets with owner and estimated impact (latency/cost/enterprise retention) and recommended experiments
Executive one-pager approved by Head of Product and Sales with recommended immediate trade-offs for Dedicated vs Hosted offerings
At least one cross-team sync scheduled with Eng/Console/Research and a follow-up plan for telemetry/evals to validate competitor claims
tasks: Define interview guide and signoff by 2026-03-12 (PM + Research)
Recruit 18 target buyer interviews (mix of infra engineers, ML leads, procurement) by 2026-03-18 (Solutions + Sales)
Conduct interviews and capture highlights; tag problem triggers and procurement thresholds
Produce competitor capability inventory by scraping docs and confirming via 6 vendor calls
Map capabilities to Redwood product surface and flag hard gaps vs easy wins

Run internal review with Eng and Console team and collect technical feasibility feedback
Publish deliverables to Confluence and circulate executive one-pager to GTM and Research
